returning: detail: making regular-season debut after missing time with an upper-body injury sustained during the preseason
away.summary: The Senators are coming off a 2-1 win over the Flyers and have a 3-1-0 record to start the season. They welcome back Andre Burakovsky to the lineup after missing time with an upper-body injury, while dealing with several defensive absences including Zub, MacDermid, Sanderson, and Crotty. Linus Ullmark is projected to start in goal and has won his first three decisions of the season.
